cunning_eyes.name: Cunning Eyes
cunning_eyes.desc: When you see a weak point of the enemy, increase damage when attacking that weak point.

blood_cloak.name: Blood Cloak
blood_cloak.desc: When you have one hp left, increase damage and become invincible for 1 second every 10 seconds.

poison_apple.name: Poison Apple
poison_apple.desc: When you eat this apple, you will be poisoned for 10 seconds.

brag_bracelet.name: Brag Bracelet
brag_bracelet.desc: When you use this bracelet, you will brag about your damage for 10 seconds.

glass_shoes.name: Glass Shoes
glass_shoes.desc: When you wear these shoes, your movement speed increases by 20%.

magic_mirror.name: Magic Mirror
magic_mirror.desc: Reflect enemy attacks back at them for 5 seconds when activated.

scream_shell.name: Scream Shell
scream_shell.desc: Emits a terrifying scream that stuns nearby enemies for 2 seconds.

fate_card.name: Fate Card
fate_card.desc: Randomly increases or decreases your stats by 50% for 30 seconds.

golden_egg.name: Golden Egg
golden_egg.desc: Grants double experience points for the next 3 enemies defeated.

cheating_dice.name: Cheating Dice
cheating_dice.desc: Always roll critical hits for the next 5 attacks.

joy-sorrow_roulette.name: Joy-Sorrow Roulette
joy-sorrow_roulette.desc: Randomly either fully heals you or deals 50% of your max HP as damage.

greedy_rod.name: Greedy Rod
greedy_rod.desc: Doubles gold drops from enemies for 60 seconds.

chaos_boots.name: Chaos Boots
chaos_boots.desc: Randomly teleports you short distances when taking damage.
